title: Leak Adjustment Schedule of Terms — Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
Schedule of leak adjustment figures for each Utility Pass-Through Service schedule.

## Figures by schedule

| Service schedule | Leak adjustment offered | Qualifying consumption (percent of baseline, at or above) | Water credit (percent of excess water charge) | Baseline periods | Adjustments per trailing 12 months | Request window (calendar days after statement date) | Credit cap (USD, water and sewer together) | Sewer credit for a leak not reaching the sewer (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Water Schedule | Yes | 200 | 50 | 3 | 1 | 30 | 250.00 | not applicable |
| Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule | Yes | 200 | 50 | 3 | 1 | 30 | 400.00 | 100 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule | Yes | 200 | 50 | 3 | 1 | 30 | 400.00 | 100 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule | Yes | 200 | 50 | 3 | 1 | 30 | 400.00 | 100 |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | Yes | 200 | 50 | 3 | 1 | 30 | 300.00 | 100 |

## Column definitions

- **Leak adjustment offered**: whether a leak adjustment may be granted on the schedule.
- **Qualifying consumption**: water consumption, as a percentage of the baseline, at or above which a billing period qualifies for a leak adjustment.
- **Water credit**: the share of the water charge attributable to consumption above the baseline that a leak adjustment credits.
- **Baseline periods**: the number of actual-read billing periods immediately before the leak period whose average consumption is the baseline.
- **Adjustments per trailing 12 months**: the largest number of leak adjustments granted on one account in any trailing 12 months.
- **Request window**: the calendar days after the statement date of the high bill within which the request, with proof of repair, must be received.
- **Credit cap**: the cap on the total credit, water plus sewer, of one leak adjustment.
- **Sewer credit for a leak not reaching the sewer**: the share of the sewer charge attributable to excess consumption credited when the repaired leak did not discharge to the sewer (an under-home supply line or a yard service line); it applies only where sewer is metered on water, which is why the Submetered Water Schedule (flat sewer fee) shows no figure.

## Boundary reading

A period whose consumption is exactly 200 percent of its baseline qualifies; one at 199 percent does not.
